senses.gloss: (I)--a son of Anenas, and father of शुचि. भा. IX. १७. ११.
(II)--a son of Bhautya Manu. Br. IV. 1. ११४.
(III)--a son of कौशिक in previous birth, born as चक्रवाह in मानस. M. २०. १८.
(IV)--a pure man is rid of his bondage by satva; from the state of निरञ्जन or separation, looks upon all equally. वा. १०२. ६६, ८०, ११८.
(V)--a sage of the epoch of the fourteenth Manu. भा. VIII. १३. ३४.
--the second stage of कामाक्षी, the first being चित्परा. Br. IV. ३९, १०.
--a particular मूर्छन having the 4th accent (music) coming out of मरुदेश; presiding deity, Gandharva. वा. ८६. ३८, ५३.
--a particular मूर्छन (music); the seventh in addition to षड्ज. वा. ८६. ४०. [page३-449+ २४]
--a Janapada of the भद्रा country. वा. ४३. १९.
--the goddess enshrined at कपालमोचन. M. १३. ४८.
(I)--the sea of fresh water. भा. V. 1. ३३.
(II)--a son of शाक्य, and father of लान्गल (राहुल-वि। प्।). भा. IX. १२. १४; वा. ९९. २८८; Vi. IV. २२. 8.
--a son of शाक्य. M. २७१. १२.
--the vow for killing a शूद्र; for murder of a woman, for reaping fruits and flowers, for cut- ting trees for injuring bony and boneless animals. M. २२७. ३४, ३६.
(I)--(प्रभाकर, s.v.); a daughter of भद्राश्व and घ्२ऋताची; one of the ten wives of Atri. Br. III. 8. ७५; वा. ७०. ६८.
(II)--one of the ten daughters of रौद्राश्व. वा. ९९. १२५.
--an Ajita deva. Br. II. १३. ९४.

--the son of पौण्ड्रक: King of काम्भोजस्: attacked with जरासन्ध the western gate of मथुरा, and the eastern gate of Gomanta, performed funeral rites to his father. In order to take vengence on कृष्ण, he worshipped शिव who directed him to pray to दक्षिणाग्नि out of which would spring up an अभिचार fire which would kill कृष्ण. He did so but the Agni was not able to meet कृष्ण's cakra and returned only to kill सुदक्षिण himself. भा. X. ६६. २७-40; ५० 11[5]; ५२. ११ [7].
(I)--an Apsaras. Br. III. 7. 8.
(II)--(सद्वती) a daughter of प्रीती and Pulastya, mother of Parjanya and wife Agni. वा. २८. २३.
--an Apsaras. वा. ६९. 7.
(I)--a son of अजात and an Andhaka. M. ४४. ८४; वा. ९६. १४१.
(II)--the adopted son of Asamanjasa. वा. ९६. १४१. [page३-622+ ३२]

--an old poor Brahman of पाञ्चल des4a who had the four चक्रवाकस् (in previous birth sons of कौशिक) as his sons, all learned Brahmans. The sons left for yoga giving a verse (on their previous births) to their old father to show it to the king and get money and land. Thus he did and got much wealth including many villages. M. २१. 3-१०.
--a daughter of वृषपर्व. M. 6. २२.
(II)--a son of Bharata. भा. V. 7. 3.
(III)--the husband of ओघवती and a sage, called on the dying भीष्म. भा. IX. 2. १८; I. 9. 7.
(IV)--a son of Dhurvasandhi and father of Agni वर्ण (of कुश vams4a). भा. IX. १२. 5; Br. III. ६३. २०९; वा. ८८. २०९; Vi. IV. 4. १०८.

(V)--a विद्याधर who mocked at Angi- rasa's ugliness and was cursed to become a reptile until [page३-623+ २५] released by कृष्ण; when he seized Nanda, कृष्ण came to his rescue, and at his touch the serpent was transformed into the विद्याधर. He bowed to the Lord and went to his region. भा. X. ३४. १२-18; XI. १६. १९.
(VI)--a तीर्थ visited by बलराम. भा. X. ७८. १९.
(VII)--a son of पुण्यजनी and मणिभद्र; an यक्ष. Br. III. 7. १२५; वा. ६९. १५६.
--an Apsara गण from winds. वा. ६९. ५७.
--a शिव god. Br. II. ३६. ३२.
(I)--the florist of Kamsa: welcomed कृष्ण with राम and presented them with choice garlands; was blessed with long life and happiness. भा. X. ४१. ४३-52.
(II)--defended the northern gate of मथुरा when it was besieged. भा. X. ५०. २०[3]. [page३-624+ २४]
--wife of शमीक. भा. IX. २४. ४४.
(I)--a son of सर्वकाम, father of कल्माष- nemi (Mitrasaha-वि। प्।). भा. IX. 9. १८; Vi. IV. 4. ३९-40.
(II)--a son of Cyavana and father of Sahadeva (सन्दास-वि। प्।). भा. IX. २२. 1; वा. ९९. २०८; Vi. IV. १९. ७१.
(III)--a son of बृहद्रथ and father of शतानीक. भा. IX. २२. ४३.
(V)--a son of वीरसेन and father of कल्माष- पाद: a friend of Indra. Br. III. ६३. १७५.
(VI)--a son of Caidyavara. M. ५०. १५.
(VII)--a son of ऋतुपर्ण. वा. ८८. १७६.
(I)--a son of दक्षिणा and तुषित god. भा. IV. 1. 7-8.
(II)--a son of Campa and father of Vijaya. भा. IX. 8. 1. [page३-625+ २६]
(IV)--a son of Cancu. Br. III. ६३. ११८; वा. ८८. १२०.
(V)--a son of रुक्मिणी and कृष्ण. Br. III. ७१. २४५.
(VI)--a son of मदिरा. वा. ९६. १७०.
(I)--the mother of ऋषभ. भा. II. 7. १०.
(II)--a देवी and consort of कृष्ण. Br. III. ७१. २५१; वा. ९६. २३४.
(III)--wife of Dharma. M. १७१. ४८.

a Kingdom;
1: Br. III. ६८. २०.
the country of Janamejaya.
2: वा. ९३. २१.
--a son of कृष्ण and रुक्मिणी: went with the sacrificial horse of his father. भा. X. ६१. 8; ८९. २२ [2]; M. ४७. १६; वा. ९६. २३७: Vi. २८. 1.

--the queen of Bali Vairocana, son of Sutapa; issueless Bali advised her to have intercourse with sage Dirghatamas; finding him old and blind she sent her slave girl (Nurse-वा। प्।) to whom were born कक्षीवान् and चक्षुष; the king found this out and persuaded the queen and sage once again; the sage agreed on condition that she [page३-626+ ३३] smeared all his body with curds and salt and licked the whole of it; she did so omitting the bottom portion; the sage cursed that her first son would be without buttocks; on her request he agreed that her first grandson would be born like that and not her son; she got five sons, Anga, Vanga, etc. Br. III. ७४. ३४-88; M. ४८. ६१-79; वा. ९९. ३४, ६८-86.
(I)--the son of चारुपद and father of Bahugava. भा. IX. २०. 3.
(II)--the son of Abhayada and father of Bahugata. Vi. IV. १९. 1.

(I)--one of the ten sons of चाक्षुष Manu; इला converted into a male: (किम्पुरुष); once when he rode into a forest on a saindhava horse, he came upon उमा's pleasure garden where he with his followers were trans- formed into females. This was due to a boon granted to पार्वती by शिव. In this womanly form Budha saw and embraced her. Aila पुरूरवस् was born of this union. Sudyumna wanted to regain his male form and prayed to वसिष्ठ. The latter waited on शिव who allowed Sudyumna to have male form and female form in alternate months. Returning to his kingdom he was not liked by his subjects. His three sons were in charge of दक्षिणापथ. In the ful- ness of time पुरूरवस् was placed in charge of प्रतिष्ठान, Sudyumna leaving for forest to perform penance; father of three sons, Utkala, Gaya and हरिताश्व (किरताश्व-वा। प्।); (Vinata-वि। प्।); being once a female had no share of the kingdom; however got प्रतिष्ठान, through वसिष्ठ's help; that was given to पुरूरवस्. भा. VIII. 5. 7; IX. 1 (whole); Br. II. ३६. ७९-106; III. ६०. १४-27; M. 4. ४२; १२. १६-17; वा. ६२. ९१; ८५. १५-19; २५. २८. Vi. I. १३. 5. IV. 1. १०-16. [page३-627+ २३]
(II)--a Mantra ब्राह्मण Ka1raka. वा. ५९. १३१; ६२. ६७.
--the chief cook of the King; they should have their hair and nails cleanly cut. M. २१५. २२-3.
